reviews.text: Our experience here is ALWAYS wonderful. The NCAH Team is kind, caring and extremely attentive to our little pup, Francis!

North center animal hospital has been incredible for our family!! They have done such a great job taking care of our pup over the last 4 years. He loves coming in and looks at the vet as a place for treats and cuddles. They are also so kind to call and check up on Lincoln after he’s needed to come get service. We highly recommend them!
Been coming to NCAH for 20 yrs. Best Vet around!

After moving to Chicago and doing a lot of research on vets nearby, I booked appointments for our two Cavaliers with North Center Animal Hospital. The research paid off as the care from Stephanie (tech) and Dr. Courtney was impressive! Stephanie set the tone for the visit by being extremely personable, caring, and knowledgeable, and this was matched by Dr. Courtney. (The clinic was also very clean with no odor.) Excellent first experience!

I came here from another vet because the vet I was at didn’t have a surgeon on staff, and Dr. Courtney at North Center was amazing with my boxer. I always have a positive experience here and I feel everyone genuinely cares for me and my dogs. I definitely recommend this place. They are the best!!

I’ve been bringing my dog here since she was a puppy, and we’ve never had a bad experience. We’ve been seen for a variety of issues as well as routine prevention care and Pepper has always been well taken care of. I always feel like everyone listens to me when I advocate for my pet which I really appreciate! The vet tech staff is wonderful, and I really appreciate the last minute squeeze ins or call backs for information from the front desk. My dog loves all the vets, but especially Dr. Courtney :) I have consistently recommended this clinic for 5 years. We are so lucky to live close by and receive the best care.

North Center Animal Hospital is truly exceptional!! The veterinarians and staff are fabulous!! We have been coming to see them for over 17 years. They were amazing in helping our older dog get through some rough illnesses. They are extremely responsive and helpful. We can’t say enough good things about them!!

I just moved from Boston and I was nervous about changing my cat's vet. The people here were so kind and supportive, making me feel instantly at ease! They were quick, but I did not feel rushed (perfect because my cat was nervous). It was all around a smooth experience and I'm happy to have found a place I trust.
Friendly, knowledgeable staff. Have gone there for years and they have consistently been great.

I have been taking all my pets to North Center for years. The quality of care and staff are absolutely great. The vets explain in detail what your pet needs, treatment plans , etc and treat your pet like it was their own.
I had Willow in for her annual exam. We had a wonderful experience.

I can't say enough good things about this place. We've been coming here for many years now and we always get top-notch care. The entire staff, the doctors are some of my favorite people and always go above and beyond for my pets through the good and the bad. We have lost some fur babies along the way, especially when we lost our beloved Loki suddenly. The entire staff did not hesitate to wait until my kids got there to say goodbye and that meant everything to us. If I'm being honest everybody's like family to us and always greet us with warm smiles and they adore my animals and I never leave feeling like they didn't receive the best care.
I would highly recommend bringing your fur babies here. You will not be disappointed
The staff is fantastic at NCAH. Everyone from the front desk to the vets are knowledgeable and kind. They are always so accommodating if we have a pressing issue and need to get our dog in quickly.
It is pricey
Everyone was just great. Oh yeah our dog Tuley was treated really good as always. Dustin the tech could not have been more helpful. And as always Dr Castillo was terrific

I have issue with the advertising of thrive giving free exams.  I brought my dog in for an ear check and was charged a technician fee which was basically the check in to the exam. That to me is the exam. Just because a tech checks me in weighs my dog and asks a few question you charge me?  It should be part of the exam tied to the thrive membership as thrive advertises few exams as part of the monthly fee.  That to me is a way to recoup money for the exam.   Sorry not buying it.

Our dogs have been cared for here for over 15 years. We had a beautiful older dog with anxiety and Dr Courtney and staff were extremely caring and empathetic about her needs. We now have a puppy who is also receiving compassionate excellent care. Leah is outstanding and we are so fortunate to have this team of skilled veterinarians on the northside. Highly recommend them.
I feel extremely comfortable bringing my 3 dogs here - Dr. Courtney is a great vet !
Nice people good service 😊

I cannot say enough about the incredible team at North Center Animal Hospital. During one of the most difficult times of my life—saying goodbye to my best buddy, Crixi—they showed a level of compassion, patience, and care that I could never put into words.
Dr. Courtney and Dr. Locher were beyond kind and supportive, taking the time to explain everything gently and making sure I felt as comfortable as possible in such an emotional moment. Their empathy meant the world to me, and it was clear how deeply they care not just for their patients, but for the people who love them.
Janet, Stephanie, Grace, Yesi, and Kristina were equally amazing. From the moment I walked in, they treated both me and Crixi with such love and respect. They created a calm, peaceful environment and gave us the time and space we needed, never rushing, always checking in with genuine kindness.
The entire team provided impeccable care—not only medically, but emotionally. They honored Crixi’s life with dignity and walked alongside me through my grief with such compassion and support. It made an unbearable situation just a little bit bearable.
I will forever be grateful to North Center Animal Hospital for the love and care they showed us. Crixi was truly in the best hands, and so was I.

THANK YOU, THANK YOU!!
